entries.title: Reviewer Cascade State
entries.owner: reviewer transient-failure backoff and route selection
entries.compatibility: Settlement performs no resolver probe: it records the failure and applies ordinary bounded escalation at the five-failure threshold. After durable backoff, the poll path asynchronously probes every terminal or pending-upstream resolution row before cap handling or a charged recovery claim. A healthy probe re-queues only the exact observed row, resets the streak and schedules the initial load-aware hold without incrementing failure breakdowns or overwriting the last failure evidence. A failed probe schedules another load-aware hold without counting a new reviewer failure. Resolution backoff scales with host load; a changed failure class or a gap over one hour starts a fresh streak. Existing durable field shapes and credential-outage boundaries are unchanged. Pre-model github-budget-deferred uses existing lastFailureModel/lastFailureAt/nextRetryAfter fields without incrementing counters. Its exact-reset hold applies only to the deferred model; existing routing may select another model before reset.
